topics.name: Missions
pages: When you successfully complete a mission you will earn Gold, Fame, Exp and Items.
After a mission is completed, you can visit the general to whom you have spoken.
If your warrior's health reaches 0 during a mission, you will fail the mission.
Any EXP and items earned during a failed mission are lost.
Also, you may lose one of the items you are wearing if you fail a mission.

topics.name: Visiting
pages: When you complete a mission or meet generals on the battlefield, you can visit them after the mission is complete.
The Visiting option is available only from the Main Menu, and only after completing a mission.
While you are visiting a General, you can acquire skills, items, gold, fame or even a stat point!

topics.name: Blacksmith
pages: You can sell and buy items at the Blacksmith.
You can enchant an item by mixing certain items together.
Try combining different items at the Blacksmith to find new ones.
You can buy, sell or give your item to other users as well as store your gold by going to Live.
Keep in mind that you have to pay tax on any item sold to another user as well as for gifted items.
Use Live > Trade > Cancel Sale to cancel the sale of an unsold item.

topics.name: Skills
pages: You can only acquire and increase your skills by visiting warriors and generals.
You can change your skills before the start of a mission by going to Management >Skill in the Game Menu.
The only way to increase a skill's level is to visit a General.

topics.name: Gear
pages: Items that can be worn, including weapons and armour, are collectively referred to as "Gear".
You can use your gear before the start of a mission by going to Management >Gear in the Game Menu.
An individual piece of Gear is classified as normal, special, or rare. Some items are hard to find.
Each piece of gear has a limitation on how long it can be worn.
Gear can only be enchanted at the Blacksmith.

topics.name: Experience
pages: When you complete a mission, you will get Gold, Fame, EXP and Items.
Your level will be increased when you acquire enough EXP from completing missions.
Your character will level up when you earn sufficient EXP by completing missions.
Every time you level up, you will receive 3 stat points to use as you wish.
You may allocate those stat points to ATK, DEF, HP, or MP.
Choose carefully, because used stat points cannot be restored.

topics.name: Saving
pages: Every move you make will be automatically saved.
You may save a mission after you clear a stage, but if you end up failing mission, the saved data will be lost.
You can save/load your warrior to/from the server by going to Live in the Game Menu.
Try playing your warrior in LIVE mission mode. Your warrior will be automatically ranked against other players.
Your ranking can be viewed in the POW Multiplayer game.
Use 'Load User Data' to load your saved warrior locally.
When you connect to Live, any saved EXP and Fame you have earned will be added automatically.
